title: Website Contact Scraper: Emails, Phones & Social Profiles

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: List of websites to extract contacts from. Domains or full URLs both work, e.g. apify.com or https://basecamp.com. Up to 2000 per run.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: How many pages to scan per website: the homepage plus up to this many minus one contact/about/support pages discovered from its links. More pages find more contacts but run longer.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Runs without a proxy by default since these are ordinary business websites. Supply one only if your target list needs it.
